question.text: Let the plane <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> bisect the line joining the points <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> at the right angles. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>c</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>d</mi></math> are integers, then the minimum value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>d</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> is

solution.text:
Mid-point of 4,-3,1 and 2,3,-5 is 3,0,-2 which lies on the plane.

Direction ratios of normal vector to the plane are 1,-3,3

Equation of Plane is 1(x-3)-3(y-0)+3(z+2)=0

x-3y+3z+3=0

a2+b2+c2+d2min=28
